summary: RoboDojo's default from 2026-11-15. fast: each joint at most 4.5 rad/s (90% of the X5 actuator's 5 rad/s velocity_limit_sim) and 60 rad/s^2, its rows certified at 5000 rad/s^3 joint jerk (the X5 publishes none; v1 certified at the unverified 1000, which held moves to about half of 40 rad/s^2). Jaws: a close approaches at the SDK limiter's 10.8 mm lead and squeezes at 5 mm once its finger stops, skips the settle look when the measured arm joints already move slower than 0.05 rad/s, and an open after a held close runs at full rate; every jaw command ends after 2 still native actions instead of 3. normal, careful, speed_m_s and the recovery retrace keep v1's caps.
